<thought>To locate a template that describes the intramolecular Michael addition cyclizing a chalcone to a flavanone, I will broaden the search criteria to include the broken carbon‑carbon double bond of the α,β‑unsaturated system in addition to the ketone and aromatic hydroxyl groups, while still requiring formation of an ether oxygen. This should retrieve a template matching the described transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
